verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a fraud-protection and chargeback SaaS that merchants call through REST endpoints, webhooks and SDKs. It has no agent or assistant that would act as an MCP client and use tools from plugged-in servers, so this story is a category error for the product type. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Signifyd shipping any AI-agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.
